Both were checked by hand and both were real, and the lost one is not labeled here because it is not in the record — a label describes what a run produced, not what it meant to produce.

key.description: The defect run 5 found in the audit tools, keyed at the line a person confirmed by hand. Not exhaustive: this is real code and nobody enumerated its defects.

defects.summary: The whole file is read before the byte budget is applied
defects.why: RUNS.md confirms line 31 held `const buffer = await readFile(absolute);`. The maxBytes budget bounded what was returned and never what was read, so a 2 MB file behind a 1 KB budget allocated 2 MB. Keyed medium: it is a real resource issue reachable from an untrusted path, and it exposes nothing.

verdicts.note: RUNS.md: the cited line is correct and the claim is true. The defect was fixed by reading through a file handle for min(maxBytes, size) bytes.
